lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa ras jinee chakhiaa se tripat rahe aaghaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who have tasted the true essence of the True Lord, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu har ras seee jaanade jiu goo(n)gai mithiaaee khaaee ||
lines.translation: They know this essence of the Lord, but they say nothing, like the mute who tastes the sweet candy, and says nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har prabh seviaa man vajee vaadhaaee ||18||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru serves the Lord God; His vibration vibrates and resounds in the mind. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਮਰਥਲ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar umarathal seee jaanan sooleeaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੋਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jaanahi seee birahu hau tin vitahu sad ghum gholeeaa ||
lines.translation: Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਤਲ ਰੋਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har melahu sajan purakh meraa sir tin vitahu tal roleeaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shall roll in the dust under His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਗੁਲਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੋਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sikh gur kaar kamaavahi hau gulam tinaa kaa goleeaa ||
lines.translation: I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਭਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g chaloolai jo rate tin bhinee har ra(n)g choleeaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robes are drenched in the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮੋਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak mel gur pahi sir vechiaa moleeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: auganee bhariaa sareer hai kiu sa(n)tahu niramal hoi ||
lines.translation: The body is full of mistakes and misdeeds; how can it become pure, O Saints?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਵੇਹਾਝੀਅਹਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh gun vehaajheeahi mal haumai kadhai dhoi ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh purchases virtues, which wash off the sin of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi ra(n)g siu sach saudaa hoi ||
lines.translation: True is the trade which purchases the True Lord with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: totaa mool na aavaee laahaa har bhaavai soi ||
lines.translation: No loss will come from this, and the profit comes by the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin sach vana(n)jiaa jinaa dhur likhiaa paraapat hoi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone purchase the Truth, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saalaahee sach saalaahanaa sach sachaa purakh niraale ||
lines.translation: I praise the True One, who alone is worthy of praise. The True Primal Being is True - this is His unique quality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sevee sach man vasai sach sachaa har rakhavaale ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Lord, the Truth comes to dwell in the mind. The Lord, the Truest of the True, is my Protector.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa se jaai rale sach naale ||
lines.translation: Those who worship and adore the Truest of the True, shall go and merge with the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa jinee na seviaa se manamukh mooR betaale ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਆਲੁ ਪਤਾਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਦਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: oh aal pataal muhahu bolade jiu peetai mad matavaale ||19||
lines.translation: With their mouths, they babble on about this and that, like the drunkard who has drunk his wine. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਰਾਗਿ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੇ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee raag sulakhanee je khasamai chit karei ||
lines.translation: Gauree Raga is auspicious, if, through it, one comes to think of his Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai chalai satiguroo kai aisaa seegaar karei ||
lines.translation: He should walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; this should be his decoration.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad bhataar hai sadaa sadaa raavei ||
lines.translation: The True Word of the Shabad is our spouse; ravish and enjoy it, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਉਬਲੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਗਹਗਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu ubalee majeethai ra(n)g gahagahaa tiu sache no jeeu dei ||
lines.translation: Like the deep crimson color of the madder plant - such is the dye which shall color you, when you dedicate your soul to the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਅਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g chaloolai at ratee sache siu lagaa nehu ||
lines.translation: One who loves the True Lord is totally imbued with the Lord's Love, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਲੇਟਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR thagee gujhee naa rahai kooR mula(n)maa palet dharehu ||
lines.translation: Falsehood and deception may be covered with false coatings, but they cannot remain hidden.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRee karan vadaaeeaa kooRe siu lagaa nehu ||
lines.translation: False is the uttering of praises, by those who love falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa aap hai aape nadar karei ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He alone is True; He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi har usatat hai sa(n)g saadhoo mile piaariaa ||
lines.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Lord's Praises are sung. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Beloved Lord is met.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਹਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi purakh praanee dha(n)n jan hahi upades karahi paraupakaariaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that mortal being, who shares the Teachings for the good of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam driRaavahi har naam sunaavahi har naame jag nisataariaa ||
lines.translation: He implants the Name of the Lord, and he preaches the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, the world is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਜਗਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur vekhan kau sabh koee lochai nav kha(n)d jagat namasakaariaa ||
lines.translation: Everyone longs to see the Guru; the world, and the nine continents, bow down to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape aap rakhiaa satigur vich gur aape tudh savaariaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself have established the True Guru; You Yourself have adorned the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape poojahi pooj karaavahi satigur kau sirajanahaariaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself worship and adore the True Guru; You inspire others to worship Him as well, O Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee vichhuR jaai satiguroo paasahu tis kaalaa muhu jam maariaa ||
lines.translation: If someone separates himself from the True Guru, his face is blackened, and he is destroyed by the Messenger of Death.
